newBusiness.name: Уча Ленд · Дианабад
newBusiness.address: София, кв. Дианабад, ул. Новачница 3, зала Уча Ленд
newBusiness.addressEn: Sofia, Dianabad, 3 Novachnitsa St., Ucha Land Hall

municipal.pointScope: Unique exact municipal postal row for the address. The owner labels this point its Ucha Land hall in Dianabad, not its Daga hall on a different street. No independently surveyed entrance or room point is claimed.

newBusiness.areaCorroboration: The owner’s location list names both halls and Dianabad; the course schedule expressly fixes the chess groups to only Novachnitsa 3. The municipality’s unique row matches both street and number. A municipal discussion/proposal from 2021–22 is not treated as proof of an adopted street rename; the current operator and supplied address dataset agree on Novachnitsa.

booking.evidence: The exact chess course page includes an owned reserve-a-child-place form and expressly describes the provider’s follow-up; the public form was opened read-only, without populating or sending it. The course’s adult marketing was inspected separately and not used to infer adult admission through the child-oriented form. No place or slot is guaranteed.

service.name: Групов курс по шах за деца
service.descriptionEn: A 10-class pass for beginner or advanced groups from November 2026 to March 2027. The pass is advertised with five tournaments. Book ahead for each class; at least six sign-ups are required. The form is a contact request, not a confirmed place.

newBusiness.termsScope: The owner publishes 100 EUR for ten visits, not for a single session or a computed per-visit rate. The tournaments are stated alongside the pass; no separate booking or refund terms, unverified VAT, guarantee or timing were imported. The inspected owner pages retain copyright; no text, logo, photographs, course materials or other protected material are reproduced.
newBusiness.excluded: No second studio, adult admissions, after-school childcare, appointments, account, child data, consent submission, payment, actual booking, copied photography or production writes.

image.limit: New brand-neutral GoRez illustration of a group chess lesson, not the actual premises or children.
